note: Small full-hookup RV campground in south-east Watertown, 1.75 mi west of I-29 exit 177, beside the owner's mobile-home community. Open, level gravel pads with little shade; restrooms but no showers. --Claude
summary: Operator page + Google + imagery: 15 full-hookup pads (back-in and pull-through), no showers, $35/night tax included ($210 week, $425 month), ~Apr 1-mid Nov, by phone/text. Price passes. Google 3.5/66 (mediocre). Long-stay: posted nightly rate, all pads sold by the night; monthly rate is low. Not waterfront; pin fine.
flags: GOOGLE: 3.5 stars over 66 reviews - mediocre (under ~4.5); the listing may also gather reviews from the owner's mobile-home community next door. Reviewer call on the reviews rule; price ($35 tax included) is well under the gate.

LONG-STAY: nightly rate posted for all 15 pads; no seasonal-site sales, minimums or age limits; but the $425 monthly rate (~$14 a night) and the 'Homes 4 Sale/Rent' business next door suggest some monthly occupancy - nightly share unmeasured, no evidence the pads are mostly long-term.
BOOKING: platform operator -> phone (no online booking; 'Check for availability below' shows nothing; call 605-886-5193 or text 605-237-0164).
FACILITIES: laundry, wifi and dump (from the sweep note) are not mentioned on the operator page today; left as stored. Garbage service is included at each pad.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed (operator: 'we are not next to a nice lake'). PIN: stored 44.8838,-97.0882 is at the entrance ~50 m from the pads - fine.
